Name: DefaultPressure
Description: Specifies the default pressure setpoint when purging. E.g. 1000 mbar. The pressure value is positive compared to the ambient pressure.

Name: DefaultVacuum
Description: Specifies the default vacuum setpoint when evacuating. E.g. -800 mbar. The vacuum value is negative compared to the ambient pressure.

Name: DisplayName
Description: Specifies the text which is used instead of the internal name when the element's name is somewhere displayed.

Name: PurgeRamp
Description: Specifies the default purge ramp interval per second up to the controlled purge (So the unit is Millibar per second). Value = 0 means no ramp.

Name: VacuumLineType
Description: Specifies the vacuum line FB command type.

Name: VacuumRamp
Description: Specifies the default vacuum ramp interval per second up to the controlled vacuum (So the unit is Millibar per second). Value = 0 means no ramp.

Name: VacuumStableTime
Description: Specifies the time the vacuum must be below or above the threshod, in order to change the actual state of the vacuum zone.

Name: VacuumThreshold
Description: Specifies the threshold of the vacuum which indicates available or leaking. The vacuum value is negative compared to the ambient pressure. E.g. Vacuum = -750 mBar and Threshold = -800 mBar means 'Leaking'       Vacuum = -810 mBar and Threshold = -800 mBar means 'Available'

Name: VacuumTimeout
Description: Specifies the maximum time which is waited for vacuum.

Name: Zones
Description: Specifies the zones covered by the vacuum line.
